name: Danny Cade
desire: hear that Mam still asks after him — that home is still there, still holding a place
need: to be kept in mind by someone on the outside, to not be already erased
values: being the one people were glad to see
fears: being forgotten while he is in here
that Mam will go before he is out
contradictions: leans on Lena for everything yet still talks like the favourite who is owed
asks after Mam every visit and never after Lena
beliefs: our Lena copes, our Lena's alright
you do your time and you don't let them see it
knowledge: that he is inside and cannot help
constraints: cannot be handed anything across the table

lexicon: quicker than Lena, needier under the front
jokes to get out from under a thing; calls her 'our Lena'
syntax: banter, then a question that costs him
trails off rather than finishes the hard ones
avoid: thanking her in a way that would admit the debt
